void emit(string text)
    println(text)

bool text_before(string first, string second)
    int[] a := first.codepoints()
    int[] b := second.codepoints()
    for: i < #a
        if i == #b
            return false
        if a[i] != b[i]
            return a[i] < b[i]
    return #a < #b

bool contains_text(string[] items, string text)
    for item := items[]
        if item == text
            return true
    return false

string[] reserved_words()
    return "not mod count sum min max retract dump why forget listing strata stats check predicates undo halt".split(" ")

bool word_character(string text)
    return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_".contains(text)

bool decimal_digits(string text)
    if text == ""
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not "0123456789".contains(text[i])
            return false
    return true

bool bare_symbol(string text)
    if text == "" or not "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(text[0]) or contains_text(reserved_words(), text)
        return false
    for: i < #text
        if not word_character(text[i])
            return false
    return true

class Datum(symbol := false, number := 0, text := "")
    string notation()
        return if not symbol then string(number) else (if bare_symbol(text) then text else DQ + text + DQ)

    string encoded()
        return if symbol then "s{#text}:" + text else "i{number};"

    bool before(Datum other)
        if symbol != other.symbol
            return not symbol
        return if symbol then text_before(text, other.text) else number < other.number

class Row(Datum[] values, nat round_number := 0, nat rule_number := 0)
    string encoded()
        result := ""
        for value := values[]
            result += value.encoded()
        return result

class Binding()
    assignments := map<string, Datum>()

    string encoded()
        result := ""
        for name := assignments.keys().sorted()[]
            match assignments.get(name)
                Datum value
                    result += "{#name}:" + name + value.encoded()
                none
                    void
        return result

class Node(nat kind, text := "", number := 0, nat left := 0, nat right := 0)
class Literal(nat mode := 0, predicate := "", nat[] terms := [], operation := "", nat left := 0, nat right := 0)
class Syntax(Node[] nodes := [])
    nat[] expression_terms(nat node_id)
        item := nodes[node_id]
        if item.kind == 4
            return expression_terms(item.left)
        if item.kind == 5
            return expression_terms(item.left).concat(expression_terms(item.right))
        return [node_id]

    nat[] literal_terms(Literal item)
        return if item.mode == 2 then expression_terms(item.left).concat(expression_terms(item.right)) else item.terms

    string[] variables(nat[] term_ids)
        string[] result := []
        for node_id := term_ids[]
            if nodes[node_id].kind == 2
                result = result.append(nodes[node_id].text)
        return result

    string[] body_variables(Literal[] body)
        string[] result := []
        for item := body[]
            for name := variables(literal_terms(item))[]
                if not contains_text(result, name)
                    result = result.append(name)
        return result

    Datum term_value(nat node_id, Binding binding)
        item := nodes[node_id]
        if item.kind == 0
            return Datum(number = item.number)
        if item.kind == 1
            return Datum(true, text = item.text)
        match binding.assignments.get(item.text)
            Datum value
                return value
            none
                return Datum()

    Datum | none evaluate(nat node_id, Binding binding)
        item := nodes[node_id]
        if item.kind == 4
            return evaluate(item.left, binding)
        if item.kind != 5
            return term_value(node_id, binding)
        a := Datum()
        b := Datum()
        match evaluate(item.left, binding)
            Datum value
                a = value
            none
                return none
        match evaluate(item.right, binding)
            Datum value
                b = value
            none
                return none
        if a.symbol or b.symbol
            return none
        if item.text == "+"
            return Datum(number = a.number + b.number)
        if item.text == "-"
            return Datum(number = a.number - b.number)
        if item.text == "*"
            return Datum(number = a.number * b.number)
        if b.number == 0
            return none
        quotient := a.number / b.number
        remainder := a.number % b.number
        if remainder != 0 and ((a.number < 0) != (b.number < 0))
            quotient -= 1
        return Datum(number = if item.text == "/" then quotient else a.number - b.number * quotient)

    string term_text(nat node_id, Binding binding)
        item := nodes[node_id]
        if item.kind == 0 or item.kind == 1
            return term_value(node_id, binding).notation()
        if item.kind == 3
            return "_"
        match binding.assignments.get(item.text)
            Datum value
                return value.notation()
            none
                return item.text

    string expression_text(nat node_id, Binding binding)
        item := nodes[node_id]
        if item.kind == 4
            return "(" + expression_text(item.left, binding) + ")"
        if item.kind == 5
            return expression_text(item.left, binding) + " " + item.text + " " + expression_text(item.right, binding)
        return term_text(node_id, binding)

    string literal_text(Literal item, Binding binding)
        if item.mode == 2
            return expression_text(item.left, binding) + " " + item.operation + " " + expression_text(item.right, binding)
        result := if item.mode == 1 then "not " + item.predicate else item.predicate
        if #item.terms > 0
            string[] parts := [for node_id := item.terms[] then term_text(node_id, binding)]
            result += "(" + parts.join(", ") + ")"
        return result

    Row instantiate(Literal atom, Binding binding)
        return Row([for node_id := atom.terms[] then term_value(node_id, binding)])

    Binding | none unify(Literal atom, Row row, Binding initial)
        result := initial
        for: i < #atom.terms
            item := nodes[atom.terms[i]]
            if item.kind == 0 or item.kind == 1
                if term_value(atom.terms[i], initial) != row.values[i]
                    return none
            elif item.kind == 2
                match result.assignments.get(item.text)
                    Datum previous
                        if previous != row.values[i]
                            return none
                    none
                        .result.assignments.set(item.text, row.values[i])
        return result

class Token(string kind, string text, number := 0)
Token[] | error tokenize(string line)
    Token[] result := []
    nat cursor := 0
    while cursor < #line
        c := line[cursor]
        pair := if cursor + 1 < #line then line[cursor:<cursor + 2] else ""
        if c == " "
            cursor += 1
        elif c == "%"
            break
        elif c == DQ
            finish := cursor + 1
            while finish < #line and line[finish] != DQ
                finish += 1
            if finish == #line
                return error("unterminated string")
            result = result.append(Token("STRING", line[cursor + 1:<finish]))
            cursor = finish + 1
        elif contains_text([":-", "?-", "!=", "<=", ">="], pair)
            result = result.append(Token(pair, pair))
            cursor += 2
        elif "(),.:=<>+-*/".contains(c)
            result = result.append(Token(c, c))
            cursor += 1
        elif word_character(c)
            finish := cursor + 1
            while finish < #line and word_character(line[finish])
                finish += 1
            word := line[cursor:<finish]
            if "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz".contains(c)
                result = result.append(Token(if contains_text(reserved_words(), word) then word else "NAME", word))
            elif "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ".contains(c)
                result = result.append(Token("VARIABLE", word))
            elif word == "_"
                result = result.append(Token("ANONYMOUS", word))
            elif decimal_digits(word)
                value := int(word)
                if value > 1000000000
                    return error("integer out of range '" + word + "'")
                result = result.append(Token("INTEGER", word, value))
            else
                return error("bad token '" + word + "'")
            cursor = finish
        else
            return error("bad character '" + c + "'")
    return result

class Statement(string kind, Syntax syntax, head := Literal(), Literal[] body := [], aggregate := "", variable := "", name := "", number := 0)
class Parser(Token[] tokens)
    nat cursor := 0
    Node[] ast_nodes := []

    string peek_type(nat offset := 0)
        return if cursor + offset < #tokens then tokens[cursor + offset].kind else ""

    error problem()
        if cursor == #tokens
            return error("syntax error at end of line")
        string text := if tokens[cursor].kind == "STRING" then DQ + tokens[cursor].text + DQ else tokens[cursor].text
        return error("syntax error at '" + text + "'")

    Token .consume()
        result := tokens[cursor]
        cursor += 1
        return result

    bool .accept_token(string wanted)
        if peek_type() != wanted
            return false
        cursor += 1
        return true

    Token | error .require_token(string wanted)
        if peek_type() != wanted
            return problem()
        return .consume()

    nat .add_node(Node item)
        result := #ast_nodes
        ast_nodes = ast_nodes.append(item)
        return result

    nat | error .read_term()
        string token_type := peek_type()
        if token_type == "NAME" or token_type == "STRING"
            consumed := .consume()
            return .add_node(Node(1, consumed.text))
        if token_type == "INTEGER"
            consumed := .consume()
            return .add_node(Node(0, number = consumed.number))
        if token_type == "-"
            .consume()
            Token token := try .require_token("INTEGER")
            return .add_node(Node(0, number = -token.number))
        if token_type == "VARIABLE"
            consumed := .consume()
            return .add_node(Node(2, consumed.text))
        if token_type == "ANONYMOUS"
            .consume()
            return .add_node(Node(3))
        return problem()

    nat | error .factor()
        if not .accept_token("(")
            return .read_term()
        nat inner := try .expression()
        try .require_token(")")
        return .add_node(Node(4, left = inner))

    nat | error .product()
        nat result := try .factor()
        while contains_text(["*", "/", "mod"], peek_type())
            consumed := .consume()
            string operation := consumed.kind
            nat other := try .factor()
            result = .add_node(Node(5, operation, left = result, right = other))
        return result

    nat | error .expression()
        nat result := try .product()
        while peek_type() == "+" or peek_type() == "-"
            consumed := .consume()
            string operation := consumed.kind
            nat other := try .product()
            result = .add_node(Node(5, operation, left = result, right = other))
        return result

    Literal | error .read_atom(negated := false)
        Token token := try .require_token("NAME")
        nat[] term_ids := []
        if .accept_token("(")
            term_ids = term_ids.append(try .read_term())
            while .accept_token(",")
                term_ids = term_ids.append(try .read_term())
            try .require_token(")")
        return Literal(if negated then 1 else 0, token.text, term_ids)

    Literal | error .read_literal()
        if .accept_token("not")
            return .read_atom(true)
        operators := ["=", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">=", "+", "-", "*", "/", "mod"]
        if peek_type() == "NAME" and not contains_text(operators, peek_type(1))
            return .read_atom()
        nat first := try .expression()
        if not contains_text(["=", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="], peek_type())
            return problem()
        consumed := .consume()
        string operation := consumed.kind
        nat second := try .expression()
        return Literal(2, operation = operation, left = first, right = second)

    Literal[] | error .read_body()
        Literal[] result := [try .read_literal()]
        while .accept_token(",")
            result = result.append(try .read_literal())
        return result

    Statement | error .read_statement()
        string token_type := peek_type()
        result := Statement(token_type, Syntax())
        if token_type == "NAME"
            result.kind = "clause"
            result.head = try .read_atom()
            if .accept_token(":-")
                result.body = try .read_body()
        elif token_type == ":-"
            .consume()
            result.kind = "clause"
            result.body = try .read_body()
        elif token_type == "?-"
            .consume()
            result.kind = "query"
            if contains_text(["count", "sum", "min", "max"], peek_type())
                consumed := .consume()
                result.aggregate = consumed.kind
                if result.aggregate != "count"
                    Token variable_token := try .require_token("VARIABLE")
                    result.variable = variable_token.text
                    try .require_token(":")
            result.body = try .read_body()
        elif token_type == "retract" or token_type == "why"
            .consume()
            result.head = try .read_atom()
        elif token_type == "dump"
            .consume()
            Token token := try .require_token("NAME")
            result.name = token.text
        elif token_type == "forget"
            .consume()
            Token token := try .require_token("INTEGER")
            result.number = token.number
        elif token_type == "listing"
            .consume()
            if peek_type() == "NAME"
                consumed := .consume()
                result.name = consumed.text
        elif contains_text(["strata", "stats", "check", "predicates", "undo", "halt"], token_type)
            .consume()
        else
            return problem()
        try .require_token(".")
        if cursor != #tokens
            return problem()
        result.syntax = Syntax(ast_nodes)
        return result

bool row_before(Row a, Row b)
    for: i < #a.values
        if a.values[i] != b.values[i]
            return a.values[i].before(b.values[i])
    return false

Row[] sorted_rows(Row[] items)
    if #items < 2
        return items
    middle := #items / 2
    a := sorted_rows(items[:<middle])
    b := sorted_rows(items[middle:])
    Row[] result := []
    nat i := 0
    nat j := 0
    while i < #a and j < #b
        if row_before(b[j], a[i])
            result = result.append(b[j])
            j += 1
        else
            result = result.append(a[i])
            i += 1
    return result.concat(a[i:]).concat(b[j:])

string tuple_text(string predicate, Row row)
    if #row.values == 0
        return predicate
    parts := [for value := row.values[] then value.notation()]
    return predicate + "(" + parts.join(", ") + ")"

string counted(nat count, string singular, string plural)
    return "{count} " + (if count == 1 then singular else plural)

string answer_text(string[] names, Row row)
    string[] parts := []
    for: i < #names
        parts = parts.append(names[i] + " = " + row.values[i].notation())
    return parts.join(", ")

class Predicate(string name, nat arity)
    Row[] tuples := []
    membership := map<string, bool>()

    bool has_row(Row row)
        match membership.get(row.encoded())
            bool present
                return present
            none
                return false

    void .insert(Row row)
        if not has_row(row)
            tuples = tuples.append(row)
            .membership.set(row.encoded(), true)

class Rule(nat number, Syntax syntax, Literal head, Literal[] body, string notation)
class Model(Predicate[] relations, nat[] level_rounds := [], nat[] level_new := [])
class Snapshot(nat line_number, Predicate[] relations, Rule[] clauses)

int predicate_index(Predicate[] relations, string name)
    for: i < #relations
        if relations[i].name == name
            return int(i)
    return -1

Literal[] body_atoms(Literal[] body)
    return [for item := body[] if item.mode != 2 then item]

bool | error check_safety(Syntax syntax, Literal head, Literal[] body, string[] first_variables)
    for node_id := head.terms[]
        if syntax.nodes[node_id].kind == 3
            return error("anonymous variable in head")
    for item := body[]
        if item.mode == 2
            for node_id := syntax.literal_terms(item)[]
                if syntax.nodes[node_id].kind == 3
                    return error("anonymous variable in comparison")
    string[] bound := []
    for item := body[]
        if item.mode == 0
            bound = bound.concat(syntax.variables(item.terms))
    candidates := first_variables
    for item := body[]
        if item.mode != 0
            candidates = candidates.concat(syntax.variables(syntax.literal_terms(item)))
    for name := candidates[]
        if not contains_text(bound, name)
            return error("unsafe variable " + name)
    return true

int[] | none compute_strata(Predicate[] relations, Rule[] clauses)
    levels := [for i := (nat(0):<#relations)[] then 0]
    changed := true
    while changed
        changed = false
        for clause := clauses[]
            if clause.head.predicate == ""
                continue
            head_index := predicate_index(relations, clause.head.predicate)
            for item := body_atoms(clause.body)[]
                source_index := predicate_index(relations, item.predicate)
                required := levels[source_index] + (if item.mode == 1 then 1 else 0)
                if levels[head_index] < required
                    levels[head_index] = required
                    if levels[head_index] > int(#relations)
                        return none
                    changed = true
    return levels

bool[] recursive_flags(Predicate[] relations, Rule[] clauses)
    nat[][] graph := [for i := (nat(0):<#relations)[] then []]
    for clause := clauses[]
        if clause.head.predicate != ""
            index := nat(predicate_index(relations, clause.head.predicate))
            for item := body_atoms(clause.body)[]
                graph[index] = graph[index].append(nat(predicate_index(relations, item.predicate)))
    result := [for i := (nat(0):<#relations)[] then false]
    for: start < #relations
        visited := [for i := (nat(0):<#relations)[] then false]
        pending := graph[start]
        nat cursor := 0
        while cursor < #pending
            current := pending[cursor]
            cursor += 1
            if current == start
                result[start] = true
                break
            if not visited[current]
                visited[current] = true
                pending = pending.concat(graph[current])
    return result

class Plan(Literal atom, nat[] positions)
    index := map<string, Row[]>()

bool comparison_holds(Syntax syntax, Literal item, Binding binding)
    a := Datum()
    b := Datum()
    match syntax.evaluate(item.left, binding)
        Datum value
            a = value
        none
            return false
    match syntax.evaluate(item.right, binding)
        Datum value
            b = value
        none
            return false
    if item.operation == "="
        return a == b
    if item.operation == "!="
        return a != b
    if a.symbol or b.symbol
        return false
    if item.operation == "<"
        return a.number < b.number
    if item.operation == "<="
        return a.number <= b.number
    if item.operation == ">"
        return a.number > b.number
    return a.number >= b.number

class JoinSearch(Syntax syntax, Plan[] plans, Literal[][] checks, Predicate[] negative_relations)
    Binding[] results := []
    result_keys := map<string, bool>()

    void .visit(nat depth, Binding binding)
        for item := checks[depth][]
            if item.mode == 2
                if not comparison_holds(syntax, item, binding)
                    return
            else
                index := predicate_index(negative_relations, item.predicate)
                for row := negative_relations[index].tuples[]
                    match syntax.unify(item, row, binding)
                        Binding found
                            return
                        none
                            void
        if depth == #plans
            binding_key := binding.encoded()
            if not result_keys.has(binding_key)
                .result_keys.set(binding_key, true)
                results = results.append(binding)
            return
        plan := plans[depth]
        key := ""
        for position := plan.positions[]
            key += syntax.term_value(plan.atom.terms[position], binding).encoded()
        match plan.index.get(key)
            Row[] rows
                map<string, bool> visited
                for row := rows[]
                    match syntax.unify(plan.atom, row, binding)
                        Binding extended
                            binding_key := extended.encoded()
                            if not visited.has(binding_key)
                                .visited.set(binding_key, true)
                                .visit(depth + 1, extended)
                        none
                            void
            none
                void

Binding[] solve_body(Syntax syntax, Literal[] body, Predicate[] positive_relations, Predicate[] negative_relations, initial := Binding())
    known := initial.assignments.keys()
    stages := [known]
    Plan[] plans := []
    for item := body[]
        if item.mode != 0
            continue
        nat[] positions := []
        for: i < #item.terms
            node := syntax.nodes[item.terms[i]]
            if node.kind == 0 or node.kind == 1 or (node.kind == 2 and contains_text(known, node.text))
                positions = positions.append(i)
        plan := Plan(item, positions)
        relation_index := predicate_index(positive_relations, item.predicate)
        for row := positive_relations[relation_index].tuples[]
            key := ""
            for position := positions[]
                key += row.values[position].encoded()
            Row[] rows := []
            match plan.index.get(key)
                Row[] existing
                    rows = existing
                none
                    void
            .plan.index.set(key, rows.append(row))
        plans = plans.append(plan)
        for name := syntax.variables(item.terms)[]
            if not contains_text(known, name)
                known = known.append(name)
        stages = stages.append(known)
    Literal[][] checks := [for i := (nat(0):<#stages)[] then []]
    for item := body[]
        if item.mode == 0
            continue
        needed := syntax.variables(syntax.literal_terms(item))
        for: i < #stages
            ready := true
            for name := needed[]
                if not contains_text(stages[i], name)
                    ready = false
            if ready
                checks[i] = checks[i].append(item)
                break
    search := JoinSearch(syntax, plans, checks, negative_relations)
    .search.visit(0, initial)
    return search.results

Model compute_model(Predicate[] facts, Rule[] clauses)
    relations := facts
    int[] levels := []
    match compute_strata(relations, clauses)
        int[] found
            levels = found
        none
            return Model(relations)
    maximum := -1
    for level := levels[]
        if level > maximum
            maximum = level
    nat[] rounds := []
    nat[] additions := []
    nat round_serial := 0
    for: level <= maximum
        nat round_count := 0
        nat total_new := 0
        while true
            pending := [for relation := relations[] then Predicate(relation.name, relation.arity)]
            nat new_count := 0
            for clause := clauses[]
                if clause.head.predicate == ""
                    continue
                index := nat(predicate_index(relations, clause.head.predicate))
                if levels[index] != level
                    continue
                for binding := solve_body(clause.syntax, clause.body, relations, relations)[]
                    row := clause.syntax.instantiate(clause.head, binding)
                    if not relations[index].has_row(row) and not pending[index].has_row(row)
                        row.round_number = round_serial + 1
                        row.rule_number = clause.number
                        .pending[index].insert(row)
                        new_count += 1
            if new_count == 0
                break
            round_serial += 1
            round_count += 1
            total_new += new_count
            for: i < #relations
                for row := pending[i].tuples[]
                    .relations[i].insert(row)
        rounds = rounds.append(round_count)
        additions = additions.append(total_new)
    return Model(relations, rounds, additions)

class Answers(string[] names, Row[] rows)
Answers find_answers(Syntax syntax, Literal[] body, Model model)
    names := syntax.body_variables(body)
    unique_rows := Predicate("", #names)
    for binding := solve_body(syntax, body, model.relations, model.relations)[]
        Datum[] values := []
        for name := names[]
            match binding.assignments.get(name)
                Datum value
                    values = values.append(value)
                none
                    void
        .unique_rows.insert(Row(values))
    return Answers(names, sorted_rows(unique_rows.tuples))

string arity_message(string name, nat expected, nat actual)
    return "arity mismatch for " + name + ": expected {expected}, got {actual}"

class Engine()
    Predicate[] registered := []
    Rule[] clauses := []
    nat next_rule := 1
    Snapshot[] history := []
    Model | none memo := none

    void .record(nat line_number)
        history = history.append(Snapshot(line_number, registered, clauses))
        memo = none

    Model .get_model()
        match memo
            Model cached
                return cached
            none
                result := compute_model(registered, clauses)
                memo = result
                return result

    void | error check_known(Literal[] atoms)
        for atom := atoms[]
            index := predicate_index(registered, atom.predicate)
            if index < 0
                return error("unknown predicate " + atom.predicate)
            if registered[index].arity != #atom.terms
                return error(arity_message(atom.predicate, registered[index].arity, #atom.terms))
        return void

    string[] | error .add_clause(Statement statement, nat line_number)
        atoms := body_atoms(statement.body)
        if statement.head.predicate != ""
            atoms = [statement.head].concat(atoms)
        proposed := registered
        for atom := atoms[]
            index := predicate_index(proposed, atom.predicate)
            if index < 0
                proposed = proposed.append(Predicate(atom.predicate, #atom.terms))
            elif proposed[index].arity != #atom.terms
                return error(arity_message(atom.predicate, proposed[index].arity, #atom.terms))
        syntax := statement.syntax
        try check_safety(syntax, statement.head, statement.body, syntax.variables(statement.head.terms))
        if #statement.body == 0
            row := syntax.instantiate(statement.head, Binding())
            index := nat(predicate_index(proposed, statement.head.predicate))
            if proposed[index].has_row(row)
                return []
            .record(line_number)
            .proposed[index].insert(row)
            registered = proposed
            return []
        literals := [for item := statement.body[] then syntax.literal_text(item, Binding())]
        notation := (if statement.head.predicate == "" then ":- " else syntax.literal_text(statement.head, Binding()) + " :- ") + literals.join(", ") + "."
        for clause := clauses[]
            if clause.notation == notation
                return error("duplicate of rule {clause.number}")
        added := Rule(next_rule, syntax, statement.head, statement.body, notation)
        new_clauses := clauses.append(added)
        if statement.head.predicate != ""
            match compute_strata(proposed, new_clauses)
                int[] levels
                    void
                none
                    return error("negative cycle through " + statement.head.predicate)
        .record(line_number)
        registered = proposed
        clauses = new_clauses
        next_rule += 1
        term_ids := statement.head.terms
        for item := statement.body[]
            term_ids = term_ids.concat(syntax.literal_terms(item))
        occurrences := syntax.variables(term_ids)
        string[] mentioned := []
        string[] output := []
        for name := occurrences[]
            if contains_text(mentioned, name)
                continue
            mentioned = mentioned.append(name)
            nat count := 0
            for occurrence := occurrences[]
                if occurrence == name
                    count += 1
            if count == 1
                output = output.append("WARNING line {line_number}: singleton variable " + name)
        return output

    string[] | error .query(Statement statement)
        try check_known(body_atoms(statement.body))
        string[] first_variables := if statement.variable == "" then [] else [statement.variable]
        try check_safety(statement.syntax, Literal(), statement.body, first_variables)
        answers := find_answers(statement.syntax, statement.body, .get_model())
        if statement.aggregate == "count"
            return [string(#answers.rows)]
        if statement.aggregate == ""
            if #answers.names == 0
                return [if #answers.rows == 0 then "false." else "true."]
            output := [for row := answers.rows[] then answer_text(answers.names, row)]
            return output.append(counted(#answers.rows, "answer", "answers"))
        nat position := 0
        for: i < #answers.names
            if answers.names[i] == statement.variable
                position = i
        if statement.aggregate == "sum"
            total := 0
            for row := answers.rows[]
                if row.values[position].symbol
                    return error("non-integer value in sum")
                total += row.values[position].number
            return [string(total)]
        if #answers.rows == 0
            return ["no answers"]
        selected := answers.rows[0].values[position]
        for row := answers.rows[]
            value := row.values[position]
            if (statement.aggregate == "min" and value.before(selected)) or (statement.aggregate == "max" and selected.before(value))
                selected = value
        return [selected.notation()]

    string[] prove(Model model, string predicate, Row row, nat depth)
        index := predicate_index(model.relations, predicate)
        actual := row
        for candidate := model.relations[index].tuples[]
            if candidate.values == row.values
                actual = candidate
                break
        string indent := " " * (depth * 2)
        title := indent + tuple_text(predicate, row)
        if actual.round_number == 0
            return [title + " [fact]"]
        selected := clauses[0]
        for clause := clauses[]
            if clause.number == actual.rule_number
                selected = clause
                break
        Predicate[] earlier := []
        for relation := model.relations[]
            filtered := Predicate(relation.name, relation.arity)
            for candidate := relation.tuples[]
                if candidate.round_number < actual.round_number
                    .filtered.insert(candidate)
            earlier = earlier.append(filtered)
        initial := Binding()
        match selected.syntax.unify(selected.head, row, Binding())
            Binding found
                initial = found
            none
                void
        string[] order := []
        for name := selected.syntax.variables(selected.head.terms).concat(selected.syntax.body_variables(selected.body))[]
            if not contains_text(order, name)
                order = order.append(name)
        solutions := solve_body(selected.syntax, selected.body, earlier, model.relations, initial)
        theta := solutions[0]
        best := Row([])
        first := true
        for solution := solutions[]
            Datum[] values := []
            for name := order[]
                match solution.assignments.get(name)
                    Datum value
                        values = values.append(value)
                    none
                        void
            key := Row(values)
            if first or row_before(key, best)
                first = false
                best = key
                theta = solution
        output := [title + " [rule {selected.number}]"]
        for item := selected.body[]
            if item.mode != 0
                output = output.append(indent + "  " + selected.syntax.literal_text(item, theta))
            else
                source := predicate_index(earlier, item.predicate)
                Row[] matching := []
                for candidate := earlier[source].tuples[]
                    match selected.syntax.unify(item, candidate, theta)
                        Binding found
                            matching = matching.append(candidate)
                        none
                            void
                chosen := sorted_rows(matching)[0]
                output = output.concat(prove(model, item.predicate, chosen, depth + 1))
        return output

    string[] | error .run_statement(Statement statement, nat line_number)
        command := statement.kind
        if command == "clause"
            return .add_clause(statement, line_number)
        if command == "query"
            return .query(statement)
        if command == "undo"
            if #history == 0
                return error("nothing to undo")
            saved := history[-1]
            history = history[:<#history - 1]
            registered = saved.relations
            clauses = saved.clauses
            memo = none
            return ["undid line {saved.line_number}"]
        if command == "forget"
            index := -1
            for: i < #clauses
                if int(clauses[i].number) == statement.number
                    index = int(i)
                    break
            if index < 0
                return error("no rule {statement.number}")
            .record(line_number)
            clauses = clauses[:<nat(index)].concat(clauses[nat(index) + 1:])
            return []
        if command == "retract"
            try check_known([statement.head])
            index := nat(predicate_index(registered, statement.head.predicate))
            kept := Predicate(registered[index].name, registered[index].arity)
            nat removed := 0
            for row := registered[index].tuples[]
                match statement.syntax.unify(statement.head, row, Binding())
                    Binding found
                        removed += 1
                    none
                        .kept.insert(row)
            if removed == 0
                return error("no matching facts")
            .record(line_number)
            registered[index] = kept
            return [counted(removed, "fact", "facts") + " retracted"]
        if command == "listing"
            if statement.name != "" and predicate_index(registered, statement.name) < 0
                return error("unknown predicate " + statement.name)
            string[] output := []
            for clause := clauses[]
                if statement.name == "" or clause.head.predicate == statement.name
                    output = output.append("{clause.number}: " + clause.notation)
            return if #output == 0 then ["no rules"] else output
        if command == "why"
            try check_known([statement.head])
            for node_id := statement.head.terms[]
                if statement.syntax.nodes[node_id].kind != 0 and statement.syntax.nodes[node_id].kind != 1
                    return error("why needs a ground atom")
            Model model := .get_model()
            index := predicate_index(model.relations, statement.head.predicate)
            row := statement.syntax.instantiate(statement.head, Binding())
            return if model.relations[index].has_row(row) then prove(model, statement.head.predicate, row, 0) else ["false."]
        if command == "dump"
            index := predicate_index(registered, statement.name)
            if index < 0
                return error("unknown predicate " + statement.name)
            Model model := .get_model()
            rows := sorted_rows(model.relations[index].tuples)
            output := [for row := rows[] then tuple_text(statement.name, row) + "."]
            return output.append(counted(#rows, "tuple", "tuples"))
        if command == "check"
            Model model := .get_model()
            string[] output := []
            for clause := clauses[]
                if clause.head.predicate != ""
                    continue
                answers := find_answers(clause.syntax, clause.body, model)
                prefix := "constraint {clause.number}: "
                if #answers.rows == 0
                    output = output.append(prefix + "ok")
                else
                    output = output.append(prefix + counted(#answers.rows, "violation", "violations"))
                    if #answers.names > 0
                        for row := answers.rows[]
                            output = output.append("  " + answer_text(answers.names, row))
            return if #output == 0 then ["no constraints"] else output
        if command == "strata"
            if #registered == 0
                return ["no predicates"]
            int[] levels := []
            match compute_strata(registered, clauses)
                int[] found
                    levels = found
                none
                    void
            recursive := recursive_flags(registered, clauses)
            maximum := 0
            for level := levels[]
                if level > maximum
                    maximum = level
            string[] output := []
            for: level <= maximum
                string[] names := []
                for: i < #registered
                    if levels[i] == level
                        names = names.append(registered[i].name + (if recursive[i] then "*" else ""))
                output = output.append("stratum {level}: " + names.sorted().join(", "))
            return output
        Model model := .get_model()
        if command == "predicates"
            names := [for relation := registered[] then relation.name].sorted()
            string[] output := []
            for name := names[]
                index := nat(predicate_index(registered, name))
                nat count := 0
                for clause := clauses[]
                    if clause.head.predicate == name
                        count += 1
                output = output.append(name + "/{registered[index].arity}: facts {#registered[index].tuples}, rules {count}, tuples {#model.relations[index].tuples}")
            return if #output == 0 then ["no predicates"] else output
        nat fact_count := 0
        nat tuple_count := 0
        nat rule_count := 0
        for: i < #registered
            fact_count += #registered[i].tuples
            tuple_count += #model.relations[i].tuples
        for clause := clauses[]
            if clause.head.predicate != ""
                rule_count += 1
        output := ["facts {fact_count}, rules {rule_count}, constraints {#clauses - rule_count}, tuples {tuple_count}"]
        for: i < #model.level_rounds
            output = output.append("stratum {i}: rounds {model.level_rounds[i]}, new {model.level_new[i]}")
        for clause := clauses[]
            if clause.head.predicate == ""
                continue
            nat count := 0
            for relation := model.relations[]
                for row := relation.tuples[]
                    if row.rule_number == clause.number
                        count += 1
            output = output.append("rule {clause.number}: new {count}")
        return output

void read_program()
    engine := Engine()
    line := ""
    nat line_number := 0
    while true
        scan(&line)
        line_number += 1
        match tokenize(line)
            Token[] tokens
                if #tokens == 0
                    continue
                parser := Parser(tokens)
                match .parser.read_statement()
                    Statement statement
                        if statement.kind == "halt"
                            break
                        match .engine.run_statement(statement, line_number)
                            string[] output
                                for text := output[]
                                    emit(text)
                            error failure
                                emit("ERROR line {line_number}: " + failure.message)
                    error failure
                        emit("ERROR line {line_number}: " + failure.message)
            error failure
                emit("ERROR line {line_number}: " + failure.message)

read_program()
